skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target with 2 consecutive strikes.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1500% ATK damage as [Specialized Direct Damage] (influenced only by advanced DMG Boost and DMG Res) to a single enemy target with 3 consecutive strikes, ignoring 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Restores all allies’ HP equal to 10% of their own Max HP × [Specialized HP] (can crit).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: [Specialized Direct DMG] 1500% > 2400% ATK. Negates [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 45% > 60%. Heals all allies for 10% > 15% Max HP as [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by points. When battle begins, gains 60% [Specialized Evasion]. Reduces [Rapid Divinity - Attack] and [Rapid Divinity - Defend] applied to the target by 40%. After any character takes action, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], and [Intimidation] from all allies.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by points. When battle begins, gains 70% [Specialized Evasion]. Reduces [Rapid Divinity - Attack] and [Rapid Divinity - Defend] applied to the target by 60%. After any character takes action, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], and [Intimidation] from all allies.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by points. When battle begins, gains 80% [Specialized Evasion]. Reduces [Rapid Divinity - Attack] and [Rapid Divinity - Defend] applied to the target by 70%. After any character takes action, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], and [Intimidation] from all allies.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: If an ally’s original Max HP is below 70% of Amai Mask’s Max HP, permanently increases their original Max HP by 30%. Gains 30% [Struggle DMG Reduction] at the start of battle. [Struggle DMG Reduction]: Reduces the DMG taken by 30%. When original HP is higher than the attacker’s, DMG Res Increase is raised to 1.5×.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: If an ally’s original Max HP is lower than 70% of Amai Mask’s original Max HP, permanently increases that ally’s original Max HP by 42%. When battle begins, Amai Mask gains 40% [Defiance Guard]. When the second round begins, all allies recover [Specialized HP] equal to 20% of their own Max HP (this recovery can crit). [Defiance Guard]: Reduces DMG taken by 40%. If Amai Mask’s original Max HP is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG reduction increases to 1.7×.
